review_binding: request_id, fixed input-manifest identity, question coverage, actual reads vs inherited evidence, limits; issue/direction/proposal references resolve
proposal_scope: small/medium/large scenarios, explicit task/asset/input/split/model seeds/loss/scale/stopping/external metric, config_only/new_code/blocked_assets; no training or new model execution

admission: aggregate scores and blind outputs only; no rowValid truth/residual; no fitting/new encoding/inference/install/official upload
authority: current decision-contract and actual controller-issued Pro prompt; Prompt17 is historical, not current workflow
